title: Issue with Adding Links in the App
body:
I am writing to report a persistent issue I've encountered with adding links in the app.

I started using this app because I found its web version to be very comfortable for work. However, when I needed to add a website link in the app, I followed the same correct process as on the web version. Unfortunately, none of my links work at all.

As a result, I had to redo all my work, which wasted a significant amount of my time. This is a critical problem that needs urgent attention.

Could you please investigate and fix this issue? Thank you.
